newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser-Busch up on beer pricing-analyst.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser-Busch up on beer pricing-analyst.

text.p: Shares of Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc rose 2-1/8 at 78-3/8 on higher pricing in the beer market, said Oppenheimer analyst Roy Burry.
He cited a Wall Street Journal story printed Tuesday that beer prices have risen nearly three percent since January.

Burry added that Anheuser, which brews Budweiser beer, raised its prices by 3.5 percent in 25 percent of its market in September 1995 and by the same amount in the rest of the market in February. Similiar increases are planned, beginning in 25 percent of Anheuser's market this month, he added.
"That's a momumental change in the fundamentals," Burry said.
Oppenheimer has a buy rating on Anheuser.
